summary: Feed s075_single to NDR is degraded: 25.7% of traffic (839/3264 frames) arrives VXLAN-encapsulated, hiding inner payload from inspection. All other visibility checks (duplicates, one-way, drops, truncation, VLAN, overload, encryption, oversize) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is forwarding overlay VXLAN traffic without decapsulation - likely mirroring a VTEP/uplink or virtual switch SPAN that carries VXLAN (VNI) encapsulation and passing it straight to the tool port.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR requires full payload inspection of inner Ethernet/IP. With outer VXLAN header intact, NDR cannot parse inner L2-L7 headers and payload for 25.7% of traffic, reducing detection coverage and causing missed lateral movement and C2 detection in the overlay.

recommended_fix.why: Strip VXLAN header at the packet broker to deliver decapsulated inner frames to the NDR, restoring full L2-L7 visibility without changing TAP/SPAN source.
